description: The white space a name must not hold (hasNameSpace in spec.go): the code points that \s matches in an ECMAScript pattern, as the schema's pattern ^\S+$ reads them. This is the white space of unicode.IsSpace without U+0085, and with U+FEFF. Go's regexp reads \s as [\t\n\f\r ] only. Read by TestNameSpaceCorpus and name-spaces.contract.test.js.
